```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |> st_make_valid()
```


```{r}
seagrass <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/seagrass/Seagrass_merged.shp") |> st_zm()
```

```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(ohi_regions) +
  tm_polygons(col = "white", border.col = "gray", outline = 0.2) +
tm_shape(seagrass) +
  tm_polygons(col = "blue", border.col = "blue")
```


```{r}
ohi_regions <- st_transform(ohi_regions, st_crs(seagrass))

seagrass_ohi <- st_intersection(seagrass, ohi_regions) |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
seagrass_ohi
```
```{r}
seagrass_ohi |>
  mutate(
    year = 2025,
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)   # Region_1 → Region 1
  ) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, area_km2) |>
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c('Region ID', 'Year', 'Extent (km²)'),
    align = c('c', 'c', 'r')
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c('striped', 'bordered', 'hover')
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    c('Seagrass Extent' = 3)
  )

```

```{r}
seagrass_ohi <- seagrass_ohi |>
  # Add condition scores
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    rgn_id %in% c("Region_1", "Region_2", "Region_3", "Region_5", "Region_7", "Region_8") ~ 0.54,
    rgn_id == "Region_4" ~ 0.3063,
    rgn_id == "Region_6" ~ 1,
    rgn_id == "Region_9" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) |>
  
  # Rename area_km2 → extent and add year
  rename(extent = area_km2) |>
  mutate(year = 2025) |>
  
  # Add trend + habitat columns
  mutate(
    trend = NA_real_,
    habitat = "seagrass"
  ) |>
  
  # Final column order
  select(rgn_id, year, condition, extent, trend, habitat)

seagrass_ohi
```
```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

# 1. Add a dummy column so tmap can create a legend for seagrass
seagrass$habitat <- "Seagrass"

tm_shape(ohi_regions) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "location",
    palette = c(
      "marine" = "#cceeff",   # light blue
      "land"   = "#f5e6c8"    # light tan
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    border.col = "gray",
    border.lwd = 0.6,
    legend.show = FALSE        # hide marine/land legend
  ) +

tm_shape(seagrass) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "habitat",                     # use dummy column
    palette = c("Seagrass" = "#228B22"), # blue seagrass
    alpha = 1,
    border.col = "#228B22",
    border.lwd = 1000,
    title = "Habitat"                    # legend label
  ) +

tm_layout(
    title.size = 1.3,
    title.fontface = "bold",
    title.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
    frame = FALSE
  ) +

tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))

```

```{r}
# Write CSVs to output_data directory
write.csv(seagrass_ohi,
          "habitat_services_output/seagrass_habitat_scores.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
